summary.zh: 统一 Python 代码风格与命名规范
summary.en: Sets consistent style, naming and docstring conventions.

description.zh: 为 Python 项目定下代码风格、命名和文档字符串的写法，并给出正误对照示例。适合新项目起步、写新代码或做代码审查时对齐口径。配置 linter 和 formatter 时也能直接参照这些规则。
description.en: Sets code style, naming and docstring conventions for Python projects, with before-and-after examples. Use it when starting a project, writing new code or reviewing style, and when configuring linters and formatters.
